name: polaroid-line-carousel
title: Polaroid Line Carousel
description: Polaroid prints pegged with wooden clothespins to a sagging string. Drag the line and the photos slide along it, swinging on their pegs and settling with a little overshoot; they sway gently at rest. Centre print is active; serif title + caption, counter and round arrows at the bottom.
darkMode: background/ink default to --color-background / --color-foreground, so it follows the theme; prints stay cream paper
mainProps: slides: {image?, title?, caption?, alt?, palette?, seed?}[], height (default 100svh), cardWidth (px, default 300), sag, swing (0 = still), autoplay (ms, default 4500, 0=off), string, background, ink, onChange
notes: Plain DOM + rAF, no WebGL, no CORS needed. Slides without `image` get a painted landscape (export polaroidPaintedSlides). Drag, click a print, arrows or arrow keys.
